polite.guest: Hola, buenas noches. ¿Tienen mesa para uno?
polite.guestEn: Hi, good evening. Do you have a table for one?
polite.reply: ¡Buenas noches! Sí, tenemos mesa. Sígame, por favor.
polite.replyEn: Good evening! Yes, we have a table. Follow me, please.

polite.guest: Buenas noches. Una mesa para uno, por favor.
polite.guestEn: Good evening. A table for one, please.
polite.reply: Perfecto, una mesa para uno. Por aquí, por favor.
polite.replyEn: Perfect, a table for one. This way, please.

polite.guestEn: Hi. Can I sit wherever I like?
polite.reply: Claro, donde usted prefiera. Sígame, le acompaño.
polite.replyEn: Of course, wherever you prefer. Follow me, I'll walk you over.

warm.guest: ¡Buenas noches! ¡Qué bien huele aquí! ¿Hay mesa para uno?
warm.guestEn: Good evening! It smells great in here! Is there a table for one?
warm.reply: ¡Buenas noches, gracias! Sí, hay mesa. Sígame, por favor.
warm.replyEn: Good evening, thank you! Yes, there's a table. Follow me, please.

warm.guest: ¡Hola! Vengo porque me lo recomendó una amiga. ¿Tienen sitio?
warm.guestEn: Hi! I'm here because a friend recommended it. Do you have room?
warm.reply: ¡Qué alegría! Sí, tenemos sitio. Sígame, por favor.
warm.replyEn: How lovely! Yes, we have room. Follow me, please.

rushed.guest: Una mesa para uno, por favor. Tengo poco tiempo.
rushed.guestEn: A table for one, please. I don't have much time.
rushed.reply: Por supuesto, enseguida. Sígame, por favor.
rushed.replyEn: Of course, right away. Follow me, please.

wrong.en: Relax, nobody's in a hurry here.
wrong.why: They told you they're short on time. Brushing that off sounds rude, so show them you'll be quick.

rushed.guest: Hola. ¿Me puede sentar ya? Tengo prisa.
rushed.guestEn: Hi. Can you seat me now? I'm in a hurry.
rushed.reply: Claro, ahora mismo. Por aquí, por favor.
rushed.replyEn: Sure, right now. This way, please.

wrong.en: One moment, I'll finish this first.
wrong.why: They said they're in a hurry. Making them wait on purpose is the opposite of what they asked.

rude.guest: ¿Hay mesa o no? Llevo un rato esperando.
rude.guestEn: Is there a table or not? I've been waiting a while.
rude.reply: Disculpe la espera. Sí, tenemos mesa. Sígame, por favor.
rude.replyEn: Sorry for the wait. Yes, we have a table. Follow me, please.

rude.guest: Mesa para uno. Y que no sea al lado de la puerta.
rude.guestEn: Table for one. And not next to the door.
rude.reply: Por supuesto, le doy una mesa lejos de la puerta. Sígame.
rude.replyEn: Of course, I'll give you a table away from the door. Follow me.

indecisive.guest: Hola... eh, ¿tienen mesa? Bueno, si no es molestia.
indecisive.guestEn: Hi... uh, do you have a table? Well, if it's no trouble.
indecisive.reply: No es ninguna molestia. Sí, tenemos mesa. Sígame, por favor.
indecisive.replyEn: It's no trouble at all. Yes, we have a table. Follow me, please.

indecisive.guest: Buenas noches. ¿Mesa para uno? ¿O mejor espero? No sé...
indecisive.guestEn: Good evening. A table for one? Or should I wait? I don't know...
indecisive.reply: No hace falta esperar, tenemos mesa ahora. Sígame, por favor.
indecisive.replyEn: No need to wait, we have a table now. Follow me, please.

tourist.guest: Hola... perdón, mi español es un poco malo. ¿Mesa para uno?
tourist.guestEn: Hi... sorry, my Spanish is a bit bad. Table for one?
tourist.reply: No se preocupe, habla muy bien. Sí, mesa para uno. Sígame, por favor.
tourist.replyEn: Don't worry, you speak very well. Yes, a table for one. Follow me, please.

tourist.guest: Buenas noches. Es mi primera vez en España. ¿Puedo cenar aquí?
tourist.guestEn: Good evening. It's my first time in Spain. Can I have dinner here?
tourist.reply: ¡Claro que sí! Sígame, le acompaño a una mesa.
tourist.replyEn: Of course! Follow me, I'll take you to a table.

impatient.guest: Por fin. Llevo un buen rato esperando aquí.
impatient.guestEn: Finally. I've been waiting here quite a while.
impatient.reply: Disculpe la espera, de verdad. Sígame, por favor.
impatient.replyEn: I'm really sorry for the wait. Follow me, please.

wrong.en: You're welcome. Follow me, please.
wrong.why: “Por fin” (finally) is a complaint, not a thank-you. Apologize for the wait.

impatient.guest: ¿Me va a atender alguien o no?
impatient.guestEn: Is anyone going to help me or not?
impatient.reply: Perdone, ya estoy con usted. Sígame, por favor.
impatient.replyEn: Sorry, I'm with you now. Follow me, please.

wrong.en: No, sorry.
wrong.why: They're asking if anyone will help them. Say you're with them now and apologize.

wrong.en: Sorry, we're closed.
wrong.why: You're open and have free tables, so this turns away a paying guest.

wrong.en: Follow me, quick.
wrong.why: “Sígueme” uses tú. With a guest you don't know, use usted: “Sígame”.

wrong.en: Good morning! Come in.
wrong.why: It's evening. After dark, say “buenas noches”.

wrong.en: There are tables. Find one yourself.
wrong.why: Leaving a guest to find their own table is rude. Lead them.

wrong.en: We have a table for two people.
wrong.why: They're on their own. Offer a table for one.

polite.reply: ¡Gracias, me alegro de que le guste! Me llamo Alex y esta noche le atiendo yo.
polite.replyEn: Thanks, I'm glad you like it! My name is Alex and I'll be looking after you tonight.

polite.reply: De nada. Me llamo Alex y esta noche le atiendo yo.
polite.replyEn: You're welcome. My name is Alex and I'll be looking after you tonight.

polite.reply: Sí, me llamo Alex y esta noche le atiendo yo.
polite.replyEn: Yes, my name is Alex and I'll be looking after you tonight.

warm.guestEn: What a lovely table! Thank you so much.
warm.reply: ¡Un placer! Me llamo Alex y esta noche le atiendo yo.
warm.replyEn: My pleasure! My name is Alex and I'll be looking after you tonight.

warm.guestEn: What a nice atmosphere tonight! Thanks.
warm.reply: ¡Gracias! Me llamo Alex y esta noche le atiendo yo.
warm.replyEn: Thank you! My name is Alex and I'll be looking after you tonight.

rushed.guest: Gracias. Necesito cenar en una hora, más o menos.
rushed.guestEn: Thanks. I need to eat within about an hour.
rushed.reply: Entendido, iremos rápido. Me llamo Alex y le atiendo yo.
rushed.replyEn: Understood, we'll be quick. My name is Alex and I'll be serving you.

rushed.guestEn: Thanks. I'm in a hurry, okay?
rushed.reply: Entendido. Me llamo Alex y le atiendo lo más rápido posible.
rushed.replyEn: Understood. My name is Alex and I'll serve you as fast as I can.

rude.guest: Bueno. A ver si el servicio es rápido.
rude.guestEn: Well. Let's see if the service is fast.
rude.reply: Haré todo lo posible. Me llamo Alex y esta noche le atiendo yo.
rude.replyEn: I'll do my best. My name is Alex and I'll be looking after you tonight.

rude.guest: Esta silla está un poco floja.
rude.guestEn: This chair is a bit wobbly.
rude.reply: Disculpe, ahora mismo le cambio la silla. Me llamo Alex y le atiendo yo.
rude.replyEn: Sorry, I'll swap your chair right away. My name is Alex and I'll be serving you.

wrong.text: Las sillas están bien. Me llamo Alex.
wrong.en: The chairs are fine. My name is Alex.
wrong.why: Arguing with a complaint makes it worse. Apologize and offer to fix it.

indecisive.guest: Gracias... ¿o mejor me siento en la otra silla? No, aquí está bien.
indecisive.guestEn: Thanks... or should I sit in the other chair? No, here is fine.
indecisive.reply: Aquí está perfecto. Me llamo Alex y esta noche le atiendo yo.
indecisive.replyEn: Here is perfect. My name is Alex and I'll be looking after you tonight.

tourist.reply: Me llamo Alex. Esta noche le atiendo yo.
tourist.replyEn: My name is Alex. I'll be looking after you tonight.

tourist.reply: Muy bien, yo también hablo despacio. Me llamo Alex y le atiendo yo.
tourist.replyEn: Very good, I'll speak slowly too. My name is Alex and I'll be serving you.

impatient.guest: Ya era hora. Llevo un rato aquí sin que venga nadie.
impatient.guestEn: About time. I've been here a while and nobody's come.
impatient.reply: Perdone la espera. Me llamo Alex y desde ahora le atiendo yo.
impatient.replyEn: Sorry for the wait. My name is Alex and I'll be looking after you from now on.

wrong.en: You're welcome! My name is Alex.
wrong.why: They're complaining about the wait, not thanking you. Apologize first.

impatient.reply: Disculpe la espera. Me llamo Alex y esta noche le atiendo yo.
impatient.replyEn: Sorry for the wait. My name is Alex and I'll be looking after you tonight.

wrong.en: Yes, here I am! My name is Alex.
wrong.why: “Por fin” means they've been waiting too long. Apologize for the wait.

wrong.text: ¡Buenas noches! Me llamo Alex y esta noche te atiende yo.
wrong.en: Good evening! My name is Alex and tonight I serves you.
wrong.why: “Te” is informal, and “atiende” doesn't match “yo”. Say “le atiendo yo”.

wrong.en: What would you like for dessert?
wrong.why: Dessert comes at the end. Start by introducing yourself.

wrong.en: Hi. Are you leaving already?
wrong.why: They just sat down. This sounds like you want them gone.

wrong.text: Me llamo Alex. ¿Y usted qué hace aquí?
wrong.en: My name is Alex. And what are you doing here?
wrong.why: This sounds like you're questioning why they came. Welcome them instead.

polite.reply: Igualmente. ¿Qué le puedo traer de beber?
polite.replyEn: Likewise. What can I bring you to drink?

polite.reply: ¿Le traigo algo de beber para empezar?
polite.replyEn: Can I bring you something to drink to start?

polite.guestEn: Great. What drinks do you have?
polite.reply: Tenemos {drinkList}. ¿Qué le apetece?
polite.replyEn: We have {drinkList}. What would you like?

wrong.en: Yes, we have drinks.
wrong.why: They asked which drinks you have. List them.

warm.guestEn: Nice to meet you, Alex! I'm really hungry, you know?
warm.reply: ¡Pues ha venido al sitio perfecto! ¿Qué le traigo de beber mientras tanto?
warm.replyEn: Then you've come to the perfect place! What can I bring you to drink in the meantime?

rushed.guest: Vale. ¿Me trae algo de beber ya, por favor?
rushed.guestEn: Okay. Can you bring me something to drink now, please?
rushed.reply: Claro, ahora mismo. ¿Qué le gustaría beber?
rushed.replyEn: Sure, right now. What would you like to drink?

rude.guestEn: Yeah, yeah. I'm thirsty.
rude.reply: Entonces empecemos por la bebida. ¿Qué le traigo?
rude.replyEn: Then let's start with a drink. What can I bring you?

rude.guest: Ya. ¿Me trae algo de beber o no?
rude.guestEn: Right. Are you bringing me something to drink or not?
rude.reply: Ahora mismo. ¿Qué le gustaría beber?
rude.replyEn: Right away. What would you like to drink?

indecisive.guest: Mucho gusto... A ver, ¿qué bebidas hay?
indecisive.guestEn: Nice to meet you... Let's see, what drinks are there?
indecisive.replyEn: We have {drinkList}. What would you like?

wrong.en: There are lots. You choose.
wrong.why: They asked what drinks there are. Tell them so they can choose.

tourist.guest: Mucho gusto. ¿Qué se bebe aquí normalmente?
tourist.guestEn: Nice to meet you. What do people usually drink here?
tourist.replyEn: We have {drinkList}. What would you like to try?

wrong.text: ¿Qué le puedo traer de comer beber?
wrong.en: What can I bring you to eat drink?
wrong.why: “De comer beber” mixes two verbs. Pick one: “de beber”.

wrong.en: Do you want the check already?
wrong.why: Offering the check before they've ordered tells them to leave.

wrong.text: Las bebidas están allí. Sírvase usted.
wrong.en: The drinks are over there. Help yourself.
wrong.why: Guests don't serve themselves here. Offer to bring the drink.

wrong.en: What do you (informal) want to drink?
wrong.why: “Quieres” is the tú form. With a guest, say “¿Qué le traigo?” or “¿Qué quiere beber?”.

polite.reply: Muy bien, {drink}. Enseguida vuelvo.
polite.replyEn: Great, {drink}. I'll be right back.

polite.reply: Perfecto, ahora mismo le traigo {drink}.
polite.replyEn: Perfect, I'll bring you {drink} right away.

polite.reply: Claro que sí. Enseguida le traigo {drink}.
polite.replyEn: Of course. I'll bring you {drink} right away.

rushed.reply: Por supuesto. Ahora mismo le traigo {drink}.
rushed.replyEn: Of course. I'll bring you {drink} right now.

rude.guestEn: Bring me {drink}. Quickly.
rude.reply: Enseguida. Vuelvo en un minuto con {drink}.
rude.replyEn: Right away. I'll be back in a minute with {drink}.

rude.guest: {Drink}. Y esta vez sin hacerme esperar.
rude.guestEn: {Drink}. And this time without making me wait.
rude.reply: Por supuesto. Ahora mismo le traigo {drink}.
rude.replyEn: Of course. I'll bring you {drink} right now.

indecisive.guestEn: Hmm... I don't know... Okay, {drink}. Yes, {drink}.
indecisive.reply: Muy buena elección. Ahora mismo le traigo {drink}.
indecisive.replyEn: Great choice. I'll bring you {drink} right away.

indecisive.guestEn: Well... I think {drink}. Is that possible?
indecisive.reply: Claro que sí. Ahora mismo le traigo {drink}.
indecisive.replyEn: Of course. I'll bring you {drink} right away.

tourist.guestEn: Uh... {drink}? Is that how you say it?
tourist.replyEn: Yes, perfect! I'll bring you {drink} right away.

wrong.text: Muy bien, ahora mismo le traigo {otherDrink}.
wrong.en: Great, I'll bring you {otherDrink} right away.
wrong.why: They asked for {drink}, not {otherDrink}. Listen closely.

wrong.text: Perfecto, enseguida vuelvo con la cuenta.
wrong.en: Perfect, I'll be right back with the check.
wrong.why: They ordered a drink. The check comes at the end.

wrong.en: Okay, you wait.
wrong.why: Too blunt, and it uses tú. Tell them you'll be right back.

wrong.en: Sorry, there's none left today.
wrong.why: {Drink} is on the menu. Don't say it's out when it isn't.

polite.reply: De nada. ¿Ya sabe qué le gustaría comer?
polite.replyEn: You're welcome. Do you know what you'd like to eat?

polite.reply: ¡Para eso estamos! ¿Ya sabe qué le gustaría comer?
polite.replyEn: That's what we're here for! Do you know what you'd like to eat?

polite.reply: Me alegro. ¿Le tomo nota de la comida?
polite.replyEn: Glad to hear it. Shall I take your food order?

warm.guest: ¡Perfecto, justo lo que necesitaba! Gracias, Alex.
warm.guestEn: Perfect, just what I needed! Thanks, Alex.
warm.reply: ¡Me alegro mucho! ¿Ya sabe qué le gustaría comer?
warm.replyEn: I'm so glad! Do you know what you'd like to eat?

rushed.guestEn: Thanks. Can I order the food now?
rushed.replyEn: Of course. What would you like to eat?

wrong.text: Todavía no, vuelvo en un rato.
wrong.en: Not yet, I'll come back in a while.
wrong.why: They're ready and in a hurry. Take the order now.

rude.guestEn: Finally.
rude.reply: Disculpe la espera. ¿Ya sabe qué le gustaría comer?
rude.replyEn: Sorry for the wait. Do you know what you'd like to eat?

wrong.text: ¡De nada! ¿Ya sabe qué le gustaría comer?
wrong.en: You're welcome! Do you know what you'd like to eat?
wrong.why: “Por fin” (finally) is a complaint, not a thank-you. Apologize for the wait.

rude.guestEn: All that waiting for this?
rude.reply: Perdone la espera. ¿Le tomo nota de la comida?
rude.replyEn: Sorry for the wait. Shall I take your food order?

impatient.guest: Por fin. Pensaba que se había olvidado de mí.
impatient.guestEn: Finally. I thought you'd forgotten about me.
impatient.reply: Perdone la espera, no me había olvidado. ¿Ya sabe qué le gustaría comer?
impatient.replyEn: Sorry for the wait, I hadn't forgotten. Do you know what you'd like to eat?

wrong.text: ¡De nada! ¿Ya sabe qué le gustaría comer?
wrong.en: You're welcome! Do you know what you'd like to eat?
wrong.why: They're complaining about the wait, not thanking you. Apologize first.

wrong.text: De nada. ¿Ya sabe qué le gustaría comida?
wrong.en: You're welcome. Do you know what you'd like food?
wrong.why: “Comida” is a noun. After “le gustaría” you need the verb “comer”.

wrong.en: What can I bring you to drink?
wrong.why: You just brought their drink. Now ask about food.

wrong.en: Do you want to leave already?
wrong.why: They just got their drink. Offer to take the food order.

wrong.text: De nada. ¿Ya sabes qué quieres comer?
wrong.en: You're welcome. Do you (informal) know what you want to eat?
wrong.why: “Sabes” and “quieres” are tú forms. With a guest, use “sabe” and “le gustaría”.

polite.reply: Excelente elección. ¿Tiene alguna alergia que deba saber?
polite.replyEn: Excellent choice. Do you have any allergies I should know about?

polite.reply: Muy bien, {dishes}. Antes de pasar el pedido, ¿tiene alguna alergia?
polite.replyEn: Very good, {dishes}. Before I put the order in, do you have any allergies?

polite.reply: Perfecto, {dishes}. ¿Tiene alguna alergia?
polite.replyEn: Perfect, {dishes}. Do you have any allergies?

warm.guest: ¡Sí! Llevo toda la semana pensando en {dishes}.
warm.guestEn: Yes! I've been thinking about {dishes} all week.
warm.reply: ¡Pues hoy es su día! ¿Tiene alguna alergia que deba saber?
warm.replyEn: Well, today's your day! Do you have any allergies I should know about?

rushed.guest: Sí: {dishes}. Y, si puede, que no tarde mucho.
rushed.guestEn: Yes: {dishes}. And if possible, don't let it take long.
rushed.reply: Se lo digo a la cocina. Antes, ¿tiene alguna alergia?
rushed.replyEn: I'll tell the kitchen. First, do you have any allergies?

rude.guestEn: Yes, for a while now. I want {dishes}.
rude.reply: Perdone la espera. Anoto {dishes}. ¿Alguna alergia?
rude.replyEn: Sorry for the wait. I'm writing down {dishes}. Any allergies?

wrong.text: Lo siento, hoy no tenemos eso.
wrong.en: Sorry, we don't have that today.
wrong.why: It's on tonight's menu. Don't tell a guest it's gone when it isn't.

wrong.en: Excellent choice. Do you (informal) have any allergies?
wrong.why: “Tienes” is informal. With a guest, use “tiene”.

wrong.text: Excelente. ¿Y qué le traigo de beber?
wrong.en: Excellent. And what can I bring you to drink?
wrong.why: They already have a drink. Ask about allergies before sending the order.

wrong.en: Perfect, here's your check.
wrong.why: They haven't eaten yet. Ask about allergies and send the order.

polite.guest: Todavía no lo sé. ¿Qué me recomienda?
polite.guestEn: I don't know yet. What do you recommend?
polite.reply: Le recomiendo {rec}. Es uno de nuestros platos más populares.
polite.replyEn: I recommend {rec}. It's one of our most popular dishes.

polite.reply: Mi plato favorito es {rec}. Se lo recomiendo.
polite.replyEn: My favorite dish is {rec}. I recommend it.

warm.guestEn: Surprise me! What do you recommend?
warm.reply: Entonces le recomiendo {rec}. Es uno de nuestros platos más populares.
warm.replyEn: Then I recommend {rec}. It's one of our most popular dishes.

rude.guest: No sé. ¿Qué es lo menos malo aquí?
rude.guestEn: I don't know. What's the least bad thing here?
rude.reply: Le aseguro que le va a gustar {rec}. Es de lo más pedido.
rude.replyEn: I promise you'll like {rec}. It's one of our most ordered dishes.

indecisive.guest: Uf, todo tiene muy buena pinta. No sé qué elegir. ¿Qué me recomienda?
indecisive.guestEn: Ugh, everything looks so good. I can't choose. What do you recommend?
indecisive.reply: Le recomiendo {rec}. Es uno de nuestros platos más populares.
indecisive.replyEn: I recommend {rec}. It's one of our most popular dishes.

indecisive.guest: Dudo entre varias cosas... ¿Usted qué pediría?
indecisive.guestEn: I'm torn between a few things... What would you order?
indecisive.reply: Yo pediría {rec}. Le va a encantar.

tourist.guest: Es mi primera vez aquí. ¿Qué me recomienda?
tourist.guestEn: It's my first time here. What do you recommend?
tourist.reply: ¡Qué bien! Para una primera visita, le recomiendo {rec}.
tourist.replyEn: How nice! For a first visit, I recommend {rec}.

tourist.guest: ¿Qué es lo que más pide la gente aquí?
tourist.guestEn: What do people order most here?
tourist.reply: Lo que más se pide es {rec}. Se lo recomiendo.
tourist.replyEn: The most ordered dish is {rec}. I recommend it.

wrong.en: Of course! What would you like to order?
wrong.why: They asked for a recommendation. This ignores the question, so suggest a dish.

wrong.en: I recommend for you to eat.
wrong.why: This sentence is incomplete. Say “Le recomiendo…” and name a dish.

wrong.en: I don't know, it's all the same.
wrong.why: A server should know the menu. This sounds unhelpful.

wrong.text: Le recomiendo que vaya a otro restaurante.
wrong.en: I recommend you go to another restaurant.
wrong.why: That's a joke at the guest's expense. Recommend a dish from your menu.

polite.reply: Excelente elección. ¿Tiene alguna alergia que deba saber?
polite.replyEn: Excellent choice. Do you have any allergies I should know about?

polite.reply: Muy bien, {dishes}. ¿Tiene alguna alergia?
polite.replyEn: Very good, {dishes}. Do you have any allergies?

polite.reply: ¡No se va a arrepentir! ¿Tiene alguna alergia?
polite.replyEn: You won't regret it! Do you have any allergies?

rude.guest: Bueno. Tráigame {dishes} entonces. Más le vale que esté bueno.
rude.guestEn: Fine. Bring me {dishes} then. It had better be good.
rude.reply: Le va a encantar. Antes de pasar el pedido, ¿tiene alguna alergia?
rude.replyEn: You'll love it. Before I put the order in, do you have any allergies?

indecisive.reply: Es una muy buena elección, de verdad. ¿Tiene alguna alergia?
indecisive.replyEn: It's a really good choice, honestly. Do you have any allergies?

tourist.replyEn: Perfect! Do you have any allergies I should know about?

wrong.text: ¿Seguro? Ese plato no es muy bueno.
wrong.en: Are you sure? That dish isn't very good.
wrong.why: You just recommended it. Don't talk the guest out of it.

wrong.en: Excellent choice. Do you (informal) have any allergies?
wrong.why: “Tienes” is informal. With a guest, use “tiene”.

wrong.text: Excelente. ¿Y qué le traigo de beber?
wrong.en: Excellent. And what can I bring you to drink?
wrong.why: They already have a drink. Ask about allergies before sending the order.

wrong.en: Perfect, here's your check.
wrong.why: They haven't eaten yet. Ask about allergies and send the order.

polite.reply: Perfecto. Su comida estará lista en unos minutos.
polite.replyEn: Perfect. Your food will be ready in a few minutes.

polite.guest: No, ninguna alergia. Gracias por preguntar.
polite.guestEn: No, no allergies. Thanks for asking.
polite.reply: A usted. Paso el pedido a la cocina ahora mismo.
polite.replyEn: Thank you. I'll send the order to the kitchen right now.

polite.reply: ¡Qué suerte! Su comida estará lista en unos minutos.
polite.replyEn: Lucky you! Your food will be ready in a few minutes.

rushed.reply: Unos minutos nada más. Paso el pedido ahora mismo.
rushed.replyEn: Just a few minutes. I'm putting the order in right now.

wrong.en: Yes, it takes a long time. Better leave.
wrong.why: They want to know if it'll be quick. Reassure them it won't take long.

rude.guestEn: No. Anything else?
rude.reply: Nada más, gracias. Su comida saldrá pronto.
rude.replyEn: That's all, thanks. Your food will be out soon.

wrong.text: Perfecto. Su comida estará lista en unos años.
wrong.en: Perfect. Your food will be ready in a few years.
wrong.why: “Años” means years. You meant “minutos”.

wrong.en: Very good. And to drink?
wrong.why: They already have a drink.

wrong.en: Perfect, here's your check.
wrong.why: They haven't eaten yet. The check comes at the end.

polite.reply: Entendido. Se lo digo a la cocina para que tengan cuidado.
polite.replyEn: Understood. I'll tell the kitchen so they're careful.

polite.guestEn: Yes. I'm allergic to {allergy}. It's important.
polite.reply: Gracias por avisar. Lo anoto y la cocina tendrá mucho cuidado.
polite.replyEn: Thanks for letting me know. I'll note it and the kitchen will be very careful.

rude.guestEn: Yes, allergic to {allergy}. Be careful.
rude.reply: Por supuesto. Se lo digo a la cocina ahora mismo.
rude.replyEn: Of course. I'll tell the kitchen right now.

tourist.guestEn: Yes... how do you say it...? Allergic... to {allergy}.
tourist.reply: Entendido, alergia {allergy}. Se lo digo a la cocina.
tourist.replyEn: Understood, allergic to {allergy}. I'll tell the kitchen.

wrong.text: No pasa nada, un poquito no hace daño.
wrong.en: It's fine, a little won't hurt.
wrong.why: Never brush off an allergy. Even a small amount can be dangerous.

wrong.text: Entendido. Se lo digo a la cuenta.
wrong.en: Understood. I'll tell the check.
wrong.why: “La cuenta” is the bill. You meant “la cocina”, the kitchen.

wrong.en: An allergy? That's not my problem.
wrong.why: It is your problem. Note it and tell the kitchen.

wrong.en: Allergic? Then don't order anything.
wrong.why: That's dismissive. Allergies are common, so tell the kitchen and keep serving.

polite.reply: Entendido. Ojo: en {conflict} hay {allergyNoun}. ¿Le traigo {safe} en su lugar?
polite.replyEn: Understood. Careful: there's {allergyNoun} in {conflict}. Shall I bring you {safe} instead?

polite.guestEn: Yes. I'm allergic to {allergy}. It's important.
polite.reply: Gracias por avisar, porque en {conflict} hay {allergyNoun}. ¿Prefiere {safe}?
polite.replyEn: Thanks for telling me, because there's {allergyNoun} in {conflict}. Would you prefer {safe}?

rude.guestEn: Yes, allergic to {allergy}. Be careful.
rude.reply: Menos mal que lo dice: en {conflict} hay {allergyNoun}. ¿Le traigo {safe} en su lugar?
rude.replyEn: Good thing you said so: there's {allergyNoun} in {conflict}. Shall I bring you {safe} instead?

tourist.guestEn: Yes... how do you say it...? Allergic... to {allergy}.
tourist.reply: Entendido. Pero cuidado: en {conflict} hay {allergyNoun}. ¿Le traigo {safe}?
tourist.replyEn: Understood. But careful: there's {allergyNoun} in {conflict}. Shall I bring you {safe}?

wrong.text: Entendido. Se lo digo a la cocina para que tengan cuidado.
wrong.en: Understood. I'll tell the kitchen so they're careful.
wrong.why: What they ordered, {conflict}, contains {allergyNoun}. Warn the guest so they can pick something safe.

wrong.text: No pasa nada, un poquito no hace daño.
wrong.en: It's fine, a little won't hurt.
wrong.why: Never brush off an allergy. Even a small amount can be dangerous.

wrong.text: Perfecto. Su comida estará lista en unos minutos.
wrong.en: Perfect. Your food will be ready in a few minutes.
wrong.why: You skipped the allergy. What they ordered, {conflict}, contains {allergyNoun}.

wrong.en: Understood. Careful: there's {allergyNoun} in {safe}.
wrong.why: Wrong dish. It's {conflict} that contains {allergyNoun}, not {safe}.

polite.guest: ¡Uy, gracias por avisar! Sí, {safe}, por favor.
polite.guestEn: Oh, thanks for the warning! Yes, {safe}, please.
polite.reply: Perfecto, {safe}. Le aviso a la cocina de su alergia.
polite.replyEn: Perfect, {safe}. I'll let the kitchen know about your allergy.

polite.reply: Muy bien. Y aviso a la cocina de su alergia.
polite.replyEn: Very good. And I'll tell the kitchen about your allergy.

rude.guest: Menos mal que alguien presta atención. Sí, {safe}.
rude.guestEn: Good thing someone's paying attention. Yes, {safe}.
rude.reply: Para eso estoy. Aviso a la cocina de su alergia.
rude.replyEn: That's what I'm here for. I'll tell the kitchen about your allergy.

wrong.en: Perfect, here's your check.
wrong.why: They haven't eaten yet. The check comes at the end.

wrong.text: ¿Seguro? Ese plato no es muy bueno.
wrong.en: Are you sure? That dish isn't very good.
wrong.why: You just suggested it. Don't talk the guest out of it.

wrong.text: Entendido. Se lo digo a la cuenta.
wrong.en: Understood. I'll tell the check.
wrong.why: “La cuenta” is the bill. You meant “la cocina”, the kitchen.

polite.reply: ¡Me alegro mucho! Si necesita algo más, aquí estoy.
polite.replyEn: I'm so glad! If you need anything else, I'm here.

polite.reply: Gracias a usted. Avíseme si necesita algo.
polite.replyEn: Thank you. Let me know if you need anything.

polite.guest: Está muy bueno, pero un poco salado.
polite.guestEn: It's very good, but a little salty.
polite.reply: Gracias por decírmelo. Se lo comento al chef.
polite.replyEn: Thanks for telling me. I'll mention it to the chef.

warm.guest: ¡Está buenísimo! Felicite al chef de mi parte.
warm.guestEn: It's delicious! Give the chef my compliments.
warm.reply: ¡Muchas gracias! Se lo diré ahora mismo.
warm.replyEn: Thank you so much! I'll tell them right away.

rushed.guest: Bien, gracias. Voy un poco justo de tiempo.
rushed.guestEn: Good, thanks. I'm a bit short on time.
rushed.reply: Entendido. Cuando termine, le traigo la cuenta enseguida.
rushed.replyEn: Understood. When you're done, I'll bring the check right away.

rude.guestEn: It's fine. Nothing special.
rude.reply: Siento que no sea especial. ¿Le puedo traer algo más?
rude.replyEn: I'm sorry it isn't special. Can I bring you anything else?

wrong.en: Are you done? I'll take your plate.
wrong.why: They're still eating. Don't rush them.

wrong.text: Me alegro mucho de que está todo rico.
wrong.en: I'm very glad that everything is tasty.
wrong.why: After “me alegro de que” you need the subjunctive: “esté”.

wrong.en: Well, there's nothing else.
wrong.why: That's dismissive. Thank them and offer help.

polite.reply: Por supuesto, aquí tiene. ¡Muchas gracias por venir!
polite.replyEn: Of course, here you go. Thank you so much for coming!

polite.guestEn: Could you bring me the check, please?
polite.reply: Claro, aquí tiene su cuenta.
polite.replyEn: Sure, here's your check.

polite.guest: Todo muy rico. La cuenta cuando pueda.
polite.guestEn: Everything was delicious. The check whenever you can.
polite.reply: ¡Qué bien! Aquí tiene la cuenta.
polite.replyEn: Great! Here's the check.

warm.guestEn: Everything was delicious! Could you bring the check?
warm.reply: ¡Cuánto me alegro! Aquí tiene la cuenta.
warm.replyEn: I'm so glad! Here's the check.

rushed.guest: La cuenta, por favor. Tengo que irme ya.
rushed.guestEn: The check, please. I have to go now.
rushed.reply: Claro, aquí la tiene. ¡Gracias por venir!
rushed.replyEn: Sure, here it is. Thanks for coming!

rude.guestEn: The check. Now.
rude.reply: Aquí tiene. Gracias por venir.
rude.replyEn: Here you go. Thanks for coming.

impatient.guest: La cuenta. Y rápido, que llevo un rato esperando.
impatient.guestEn: The check. And quickly, I've been waiting a while.
impatient.reply: Disculpe la espera. Aquí tiene la cuenta.
impatient.replyEn: Sorry for the wait. Here's the check.

wrong.text: Por supuesto. Hoy la cena es gratis.
wrong.en: Of course. Dinner is free tonight.
wrong.why: Wrong information. Don't promise a free meal.

wrong.text: ¿Otra vez? Ya le di la cuenta.
wrong.en: Again? I already gave you the check.
wrong.why: You haven't brought it yet, and the tone is rude.

wrong.text: Claro, aquí tiene su cuenta. Que tenga buenos días.
wrong.en: Sure, here's your check. Have a good morning.
wrong.why: It's night. Say “buenas noches”.

wrong.en: Here's (informal) the check.
wrong.why: “Tienes” is the tú form. With a guest, say “aquí tiene”.

polite.guest: Aquí tiene. Muchas gracias por todo.
polite.guestEn: Here you go. Thank you for everything.
polite.reply: ¡Gracias a usted! Que tenga muy buena noche.
polite.replyEn: Thank you! Have a very good night.

polite.reply: ¡Muchas gracias, es muy amable! Vuelva pronto.
polite.replyEn: Thank you so much, that's very kind! Come back soon.

warm.guestEn: I'll definitely be back soon! Thanks, Alex.
warm.replyEn: We'll look forward to it! Have a good night.

rude.guestEn: Here. Bye.
rude.reply: Gracias por venir. Buenas noches.
rude.replyEn: Thanks for coming. Good night.

wrong.text: De nada. ¿Qué le traigo de beber?
wrong.en: You're welcome. What can I bring you to drink?
wrong.why: They're leaving. Thank them and say goodbye.

wrong.en: Thanks! Good morning.
wrong.why: It's night. Say “buenas noches”.

wrong.en: Only this much for a tip?
wrong.why: Never comment on the tip. Thank the guest.

wrong.en: Thanks. Have (informal) a good night.
wrong.why: “Tengas” is the tú form. With a guest, say “que tenga buena noche”.
